$comment: OpenCharm brand and device tokens. Face colours, faces and agent states live in packages/design/faces.json (generated from packages/design/src/charm-face.js).

brand.look: White and black: a technical drawing on paper. Off-white ground with a faint grid, black ink, mono labels, dimension lines. Colour lives on the device only. Single theme by design.
rules: Orange (signal) means only one thing: it needs you.
Flat. No glow, gradients or light effects on the device or the face.
The screen is true black; only the glyphs light up.
Pages are black and white; the charm (and its chosen colour) is the only colour on the page.
A white shell on the page gets a 1px hairline (rgba(0,0,0,.12)) so it reads on white.

icon.screenShape: squircle, superellipse n=3.5 (corner about 31% of its width)
icon.file: full-bleed square, no rounding baked in; platforms apply their own mask. In HTML use border-radius 22.37%.

type.mono: Geist Mono (Google Fonts), fallback ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas

motion.reducedMotion: no blinks, glances, pops or typing; text appears at once
